title: Marketing and Advertising Agency in Lebanon - Spirit

facts.fact: Spirit describes itself as one of the leading creative advertising agencies in Beirut and Dubai.
facts.quote: We are one of the leading creative advertising agencies in Beirut and Dubai, offering a wide range of services

facts.fact: Spirit's Beirut office is at 139 Charles Malek Avenue, with telephone +961 21 333 991.
Spirit's Dubai office is located at Dubai Media City, Business Center.
Spirit's job posting for Senior Graphic Designer (Branding, Beirut office) requires 4 or more years of experience in a reputable branding agency.

facts.fact: Spirit's job posting for Graphic Designer (Beirut office) requires 2 or more years of experience in a reputable branding agency.
